h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panvel

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panvel

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Panvel

c: Panvel is only about 48 km from our Vasai factory, so a Fun Fitness order for the city travels a short road trip from the shop floor to your site. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Panvel for housing societies in New Panvel, Kamothe, Kalamboli and Kharghar. We also supply schools, colleges and the parks run by the Panvel Municipal Corporation.

Much of Panvel is new construction, and many societies here are still deciding how to use the open space left by the builder. A small open gym takes far less room than a clubhouse gym and needs no staff. The Konkan monsoon is the real test. It is long and very heavy, and the air stays humid for months, so we galvanise every frame and set each machine on a raised, well-drained base.

richText.heading: Using a podium or setback strip in a new society

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 48 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can a society committee in Panvel visit your factory before ordering?
items.a: Please call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 to discuss a visit to our Vasai factory. Working hours are Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM.

items.q: What base suits Panvel's heavy monsoon?
items.a: A raised concrete footing with a slight slope away from each machine. Clear silt and standing water after heavy rain, and check that the machines are firm once the monsoon ends.

items.q: Can the gym be installed before the society takes handover from the builder?
items.a: Yes. Many builders order outdoor gym equipment along with the play area. Share the amenity plan, and we will send a layout drawing and quote to the builder or society.
